profile.name: 站点控制网络客户端
profile.description: 用于通过套接字连接实验站点服务并保持会话的非实体软件组件，可发送命令、接收响应，并按“knob”名称查询或设置远程配置项，适合实验控制系统中的远程参数访问与管理。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component that connects to a site service over a socket and keeps the session open. It can send commands, receive replies, and query or set remote configuration items by "knob" name for remote parameter access and management in lab control software.

registry.name: D-TACQ Solutions Siteclient
registry.description: Siteclient是由D-TACQ Solutions生产的专业实验设备。connects and holds open a socket to defined port
